landmarks.label: Top of head
landmarks.evidence: first silhouette row at or above 3% of the widest row (9 px)

landmarks.label: Lowest point of the feet
landmarks.evidence: last silhouette row at or above the 3% width floor

landmarks.label: Left shoulder (image left)
landmarks.evidence: outermost foreground pixel on the row of steepest sustained widening

landmarks.label: Right shoulder (image right)
landmarks.evidence: outermost foreground pixel on the row of steepest sustained widening

landmarks.label: Shoulder line
landmarks.evidence: row of steepest sustained widening in the upper third

landmarks.label: Neck
landmarks.evidence: narrowest smoothed row between the top of the head and the shoulder line

landmarks.label: Chin
landmarks.evidence: placed one jaw-thickness above the neck narrowing; the jawline itself is not resolved at this resolution

landmarks.label: Hip line
landmarks.evidence: widest smoothed row below the shoulder line

landmarks.label: Crotch
landmarks.evidence: first row below the hip whose central band (±17 px) is empty

landmarks.label: Left hand (image left)
landmarks.evidence: lowest row with three separate runs; the outer runs are the arms

landmarks.label: Right hand (image right)
landmarks.evidence: lowest row with three separate runs; the outer runs are the arms

landmarks.label: Knee (both)
landmarks.evidence: halfway between the crotch and the lowest row; not detectable in a single silhouette

landmarks.label: Ankle (both)
landmarks.evidence: 6% of the leg length above the lowest row; not detectable in a single silhouette

landmarks.label: Left eye (image left)
landmarks.evidence: darkest pixel in the left half of the head band, 48% of the way from the head median to the darkest 5%

landmarks.label: Right eye (image right)
landmarks.evidence: darkest pixel in the right half of the head band, same height as its pair

notes: The face is a region of the head, not a detected facial surface: no face-landmark model is used, and the eyes are the only face features measured.
Hair is identified as the upper head region; where hair ends and face begins is not separable from one photograph without a segmentation model.
Clothing is the region a garment covers (torso, pelvis, upper legs); the image does not separate cloth from skin by colour in this scene.
Metric values use an assumed height of 1.70 m; the image carries no scale reference, so this is a declared assumption, not a measurement.
